# laravelforge_site_horizon (Data Source)

Fetches the Laravel Horizon integration status of a Laravel Forge site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site whose Horizon integration is fetched.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (String) Whether the Horizon integration is enabled.
- `horizon_installed` (Boolean) Whether Laravel Horizon is installed on the site.
